title: Learn 20 Action Verbs
description: Build everyday English vocabulary with 20 useful action verbs, simple meanings and practical example sentences.

body_markdown:
## 1. What is an action verb?

An action verb tells us what a person, animal or thing does. Examples: walk, write, cook and drive.

## 2. Learn these 20 action verbs

| Verb | Simple meaning | Example |
|---|---|---|
| walk | move on foot | I walk to the bus stop. |
| run | move quickly on foot | They run in the park. |
| eat | take food | We eat lunch at one. |
| drink | take a liquid | She drinks water. |
| read | understand written words | I read a book. |
| write | make words on paper | He writes a letter. |
| speak | say words | Please speak slowly. |
| listen | pay attention to sound | I listen to the teacher. |
| watch | look at something for a time | We watch the news. |
| cook | prepare food | My mother cooks dinner. |
| clean | remove dirt | I clean my room. |
| open | move something so it is not closed | Open the window. |
| close | shut something | Please close the door. |
| carry | take something with you | He carries a bag. |
| drive | control a vehicle | She drives a car. |
| help | make a task easier for someone | I help my friend. |
| learn | gain knowledge or a skill | We learn English. |
| teach | help someone learn | They teach children. |
| buy | get something by paying | I buy vegetables. |
| sell | give something for money | They sell fruit. |

## 3. Use verbs with different subjects

- I walk every morning.
- He walks every morning.
- They walk every morning.

Remember: in the present simple tense, add **-s** or **-es** to most verbs after he, she or it.

## 4. Make your own sentences

Choose five verbs from the table. Write one sentence about yourself for each verb. Example: “I read the newspaper every morning.”

## 5. Quick practice

Fill in the blanks with a suitable verb: **cook, drive, listen, clean, buy**.

1. I ______ to music.
2. We ______ vegetables from the market.
3. My father can ______ a bus.
4. They ______ the classroom.
5. I ______ dinner at home.

**Answers:** 1. listen, 2. buy, 3. drive, 4. clean, 5. cook.

## 6. Speaking task

Describe your day using at least eight action verbs. Start with: “I wake up, wash my face and…”

faq.question: What is an action verb?
faq.answer: An action verb describes an action, such as walk, read, cook or drive.

faq.question: Can one verb be used with different subjects?
faq.answer: Yes. For example: I work, you work, but he works in the present simple tense.

faq.question: How many verbs should a beginner learn daily?
faq.answer: Start with five to ten useful verbs and practise them in your own sentences.
